_metadata.description: Every operation family is reachable headlessly with report-shaped output; the UI enhances and never gates.

requirements.title: Headless composition operation
requirements.description: Composition draws its operation name from the scenario vocabulary and completes from the CLI with no UI, no ComfyUI, and no interactive prompt, emitting report-shaped output. Analysis and transformation are explicit later-scope capabilities.

validation.notes: Composition is covered by the shipped headless composition tests
CLI domain dispatch is covered by the shipped CLI tests

requirements.title: Deterministic ops need no model
requirements.description: Trim, fade, concat, format and sample-rate conversion, silence trim, and loudness measurement run with zero model download and zero GPU, so the scenario is useful before any weights are installed.

validation.notes: Explicit later-scope deterministic operations; no implementation is claimed by this composition slice
